end.summary:
Recognised halves, thirds and quarters as equal parts in shapes.
Found 1/3 of 9 as 3 and 1/3 of 12 as 4 with prompting.
Compared 1/2, 1/3 and 1/4 correctly using equal-sized pieces.
Teach-back was not passed; no misconception recorded.
end.parentNote: Asha practised fractions as equal shares, including naming equal parts, finding a fraction of a collection, and comparing unit fractions. Nisha used the idea of equal-sized pieces well when explaining why some flags and watermelons did or did not show quarters or thirds, and later found one-third of 9 and 12. At home, share small groups of objects into 2, 3, or 4 equal groups and ask how many objects are in one group.
